invoices_kify_canonical_snapshot_check.name: invoices_kify_canonical_snapshot_check
invoices_kify_canonical_snapshot_check.value: "invoices"."provider"::text <> 'kify' or ("invoices"."canonical_invoice_number" is not null and "invoices"."canonical_status" is not null and "invoices"."canonical_snapshot" is not null and "invoices"."canonical_snapshot_sha256" is not null)

subscription_onboarding_consents_token_s.name: subscription_onboarding_consents_token_storage_check
subscription_onboarding_consents_token_s.value:
(
        ("subscription_onboarding_consents"."consent_token_hash" is null and "subscription_onboarding_consents"."consent_token_ciphertext" is null and "subscription_onboarding_consents"."consent_token" is not null)
        or ("subscription_onboarding_consents"."consent_token_hash" is not null and "subscription_onboarding_consents"."consent_token_ciphertext" is not null)
      )

subscription_operation_requests_cancella.name: subscription_operation_requests_cancellation_dates_check
subscription_operation_requests_cancella.value:
"subscription_operation_requests"."operation" <> 'cancel'
        or (
          "subscription_operation_requests"."cancellation_effect" = 'immediate'
          and "subscription_operation_requests"."paid_period_end_at" is null
        )
        or (
          "subscription_operation_requests"."cancellation_effect" = 'end_of_paid_period'
          and "subscription_operation_requests"."paid_period_end_at" is not null
          and "subscription_operation_requests"."paid_period_end_at" >= "subscription_operation_requests"."requested_effective_at"
        )

subscriptions_term_mode_total_payments_c.name: subscriptions_term_mode_total_payments_check
subscriptions_term_mode_total_payments_c.value:
(
        "subscriptions"."subscription_term_mode" = 'fixed_term'
        and "subscriptions"."total_payments" is not null
      ) or (
        "subscriptions"."subscription_term_mode" = 'open_ended'
        and "subscriptions"."total_payments" is null
      )
